```{r}

library(kableExtra)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)

here("scripts/functions.R") %>% 
  source()

# custom functions --------------------------------------------------------

# Style for tabular output:

my_kable_style <-
  function(.kable) {
    .kable %>% 
      kable_styling(
        latex_options = 
          c(
            "striped",
            "hold_position"
          ),
        full_width = FALSE,
        position = "left",
        font_size = 10
      )
  }

# Format point counts and coverboards for a given day:

pred_counts <- 
  function(.day) {
    schedule_list %>% 
      pluck(.day) %>% 
      mutate(
        Time = 
          str_c(date, sunrise) %>% 
          {
            ymd_hm(.) + 
              minutes(40 * (patch_order - 1))
          } %>% 
          format("%H:%M")
      ) %>% 
      select(
        Time,
        Patch = patch_count,
        Coverboards = boards,
        `Check nests` = check_nests
      ) %>% 
      kable(
        booktabs = TRUE,
        align =
          c(
            "c",
            "l",
            "c",
            "l"
          )
      ) %>% 
      my_kable_style()
  }

# Nest searching order:

nest_searching <- 
  function(.day) {
    schedule_list %>% 
      pluck(.day) %>% 
      arrange(
        desc(patch_order)
      ) %>% 
      pull(patch_count) %>% 
      str_flatten(collapse = " \u2192 ")
  }

# get and process data ----------------------------------------------------

next_nest_checks <-
  here("data", "temp_nest_checking.rds") %>% 
  read_rds()

schedule <- 
  here("data", "season_schedule.rds") %>% 
  read_rds() %>% 
  unnest(patch_counts) %>% 
  unnest(boards) %>% 
  filter(
    week ==
      week(today() + 1) - 18,
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    boards = 
      str_flatten(board_id, collapse = ", "),
    .by = !board_id
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    next_nest_checks,
    by = join_by(date == date, patch_count == patch)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    check_nests = replace_na(check_nests, "-")
  )

schedule_list <-
  schedule %>% 
  split(schedule$day)

```

# Weekly schedule: `r pretty_date_range(schedule)`

We will arrive at dawn to have time for set-up and travel to the point count location. The first point count starts at sunrise. We will arrive at the point count location a few minutes before then to let the birds settle down before beginning.

```{r, results = "asis"}

day_names <- 
  c(
    Mon = "Monday",
    Tue = "Tuesday",
    Wed = "Wednesday",
    Thu = "Thursday",
    Fri = "Friday",
    Sat = "Saturday"
  )

days_ordered <- 
  intersect(
    names(day_names),
    names(schedule_list)
  )

days_ordered %>% 
  map_chr(
    \(day) {
      day_data <- 
        schedule_list[[day]] %>% 
        select(
          date,
          arrive:helper
        ) %>% 
        distinct()
      
      str_c(
        "\n## ", day_names[day], " ", make_pretty_dates(day_data$date), "\n\n",
        "*Helper: ", day_data$helper, "*\\\n",
        "**Arrival**: ", day_data$arrive, "\\\n",
        "**Sunrise**: ", day_data$sunrise, "\\\n",
        "\n\n",
        "**Point count times, coverboards, and nests to check**:\n\n",
        as.character(pred_counts(.day = day)), "\n\n",
        "\\vspace{0.1em}\n\n",
        "**Nest searching**: ", nest_searching(.day = day), "\n\n"
      )
    }
  ) %>% 
  str_flatten() %>% 
  cat()
```
